name: Progress M1-9
about: Progress M1-9 (2002-045A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M1), launched 2002 Sep 25. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2002 Sep 27), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
